verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Pika uses a credit-based model, with monthly credit allotments, top-ups, and a pricing-page card that suggests a plan from your expected monthly usage. Nothing documents a per-generation cost preview before running a job, or any usage or spend history afterward. Plan-level credit sizing is an adjacent feature, not the capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see what a generation will cost in credits or dollars before running it, and track spend afterwards
